caption_verbatim: The Welcher basal angle is formed at the intersection of the nasion-tuberculum line and the tuberculum-basion line. Its average should always be less than 140°. This angle is increased in platybasia. Wackenheim's line is constructed by drawing a line along the clivus and extrapolating it inferiorly into the upper cervical spinal canal. This line should fall tangental [sic] to the posterior aspect of the tip of the odontoid process. The angle formed at the intersection of Wackenheim's line with a line constructed along the posterior surface of the axis body and odontoid process (craniovertebral or clivus-canal angle) normally ranges between 150° and 180°. Normally, the anterior arch of the atlas typically lies below Chamberlain's line. The dens is 3.6 to 6.6 mm below the line.
